title: State of the Arabic Web: table
description: The rows of aggregates.parquet / aggregates.csv: one category of a metric in one cell (all pages, a country, a platform, or both). No row is a site. Licence CC BY 4.0.

country.description: The country code, for the scopes that have one.

platform.description: The platform id (`none` and `other` too), for the scopes that have one.

category.description: The metric’s category: yes or no for a binary metric.

judged.description: Sites judged for the metric in the cell: the denominator.

share.description: The category's share of the sites judged. In the scope `all` it is weighted by the size of each country's list; elsewhere it is `sites` over `judged`.

lo.description: The lower end of the 95% interval of the share of `yes`; null for the other categories and for a distribution.

hi.description: The upper end of that interval.
